label: Home
depicts: House outline with a centered door panel under one peaked roof

avoid_when: Do not use for the chimney house when the right roof edge should include a visible chimney post.

label: Home
depicts: House outline with one right chimney post beside a peaked roof
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact house outline with a small chimney rising on the right side.
avoid_when: Do not use for the centered door house when the roofline should stay clean without a chimney.

label: Horn
depicts: Megaphone horn with one lower stand stem and one wide mouth opening
use_when: Use when the interface wants a megaphone horn drawn with a lower stand stem instead of a side handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the handled megaphone when the grip should hang from the lower right edge.

label: Horn
depicts: Megaphone horn with one lower right handle and one wide mouth opening
use_when: Use when the interface wants a megaphone with a handle hanging from the lower right side.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standing horn when a straight support stem should appear under the body.

label: House
depicts: Modern house block with one left roof slope and one centered doorway below
